question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Grandeur
solution:
The correct answer is: **Magnificence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Grandeur"** refers to impressive or outstanding beauty, splendor, or magnificence. It signifies greatness in appearance or style. (भव्यता)

 
 
• **Example:** The grandeur of the royal palace left the visitors in awe.
 
 
 
• **"Magnificence"** is used to describe something that is extremely beautiful, impressive, or splendid, which perfectly aligns with the meaning of grandeur. (शानदारता)
 
 
• **Example:** The magnificence of the sunset over the mountains was breathtaking.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **"Grandeur"** is **"Magnificence"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Magnificence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dominance** (प्रभुत्व): The power to control or influence others.

 
 
• **Example:** His dominance in the game was evident from the very beginning.
 
 
 
• **Reality** (वास्तविकता): The state of things as they actually exist, as opposed to an idealized version.
 
 
• **Example:** The reality of the situation is much harsher than we anticipated.
 
 
 
• **Integrity** (अखंडता): The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.
 
 
• **Example:** His integrity is what sets him apart as a leader.
